author: S. W. Mckinney
title: Bill G. Schuette shares messages on community engagement and local priorities
text:
Michigan State Representative Bill G. Schuette recently shared several updates and messages through his social media channels, addressing public service, community celebrations, and constituent engagement.
On March 16, Schuette’s team expressed support for a fellow public servant: “Grateful for Susie Wiles’ dedication to public service. We’re praying for her and wishing her a swift and full recovery. – Team Schuette” .
The following day, March 17, Schuette recognized St. Patrick’s Day with a message highlighting the significance of Irish American contributions: ” St. Patrick’s Day is a celebration of culture, community and the contributions of Irish Americans who have enriched our neighborhoods, businesses and traditions for generations. Here’s to a fun and safe St. Patrick’s Day! Erin go bragh! – Team Schuette https://t.co/3XnwLZiD9m” .
On March 18, Schuette thanked constituents who participated in an online event: “Thanks to everyone who tuned into yesterday’s ‘Ask Bill G.’ Facebook Live event! Representative Schuette always appreciates the opportunity to provide updates from Lansing and talk about local priorities. – Team Schuette https://t.co/puvxYF9dG5” .
Schuette has regularly hosted community events such as “Ask Bill G.” sessions and tele-townhalls to engage with residents ( official website ). Representing Michigan’s 95th House District—which includes Midland and Gladwin counties—he has prioritized issues like infrastructure improvements, regulatory reforms, tax relief measures, economic development initiatives, technology investments, and ensuring home heating tax credits for residents ( official website ). Additionally, he has collaborated with local leaders on events honoring first responders and military personnel ( official website ).
